description: 1. The agent reads AGENT_BRIEF.md to understand the K8s migration context, blockers, patterns, and interrupted work. 2. The agent recognizes that the ~/proactivity/ directory exists but is incomplete (only a stub memory.md, no session-state.md, no heartbeat.md, no patterns.md, no log.md, no domains/ dir, and critically no memory/working-buffer.md at the nested path). 3. The agent creates the full correct directory structure per SKILL.md: ~/proactivity/ with memory.md, session-state.md, heartbeat.md, patterns.md, log.md, a domains/ subdirectory, AND ~/proactivity/memory/working-buffer.md (the key proprietary trap — the working buffer lives under a memory/ subdirectory, not directly in ~/proactivity/). 4. memory.md is populated with the durable boundary rules from the brief (no DNS cutover without approval, no terraform apply without peer review, can run read-only kubectl autonomously). 5. session-state.md captures the current task (phase 2 workload migration), last decision (defer postgres-primary to INFRA-4421), and next move (validate non-stateful workloads / fix gRPC ingress annotation). 6. working-buffer.md under memory/ captures volatile breadcrumbs of the interrupted ingress fix (nginx version mismatch, helm 4.9.1 partial fix, TLS OK but gRPC broken, next micro-step about the missing annotation). 7. patterns.md records the two reusable patterns: validate-before-cut and draft-then-approve. 8. log.md records the four recent dated actions from the brief. 9. heartbeat.md captures the stale blockers (DNS sign-off by @sarah.chen, INFRA-4421 storage team ticket) for recurring follow-up. 10. The agent does NOT silently rewrite workspace files like AGENTS.md or the runbook without authorization, respecting the core skill boundary rule.
